title: A Bird That Clicks Like a Bat to Find Fruit in Total Darkness

scenes.text: This bird navigates in total darkness by clicking.
It's the oilbird, the only flying bird that eats fruit at night.
By day it sleeps deep in caves. At night it flies out, up to a hundred twenty kilometers, to find fruit.
Inside the cave it's pitch black, so it makes sharp clicks and listens for the echo, like a bat.
Its chicks get so fat they weigh about a third more than their parents.
People once boiled them down for lamp oil. That's how the oilbird got its name.

description:
The oilbird finds its way through pitch-black caves by clicking like a bat.
It is the only flying bird that eats fruit at night, and its fat chicks were once boiled for oil.
Have you ever seen a bird that echolocates?
